fields.name: LoggingExtensions.SqlConnectionStringBuilt
fields.contract: public static void SqlConnectionStringBuilt(this ILogger logger, string connectionString) — logs, at Debug level under event id ConnectionStringBuilt (0, event name "SqlConnectionStringBuilt"), the message template "A new connection string was built with a value of {ConnectString}." with the given connectionString as its single logged argument. The backing delegate is compiled once by LoggerMessage.Define in the type's static constructor; the call site adds no IsEnabled guard, so when Debug is disabled the cost is only the compiled delegate's own internal level check. This method only reports a connection string the caller already built; LoggerExtensions.cs does not establish who builds it, from what source, or with what technology.
